item.title: Greater Williamson Road Area Business Association rolls out Restaurant Week
item.description: You don't have to jet off to the Caribbean, Mexico or the Middle East to sample authentic cuisine from those parts of the world. Instead the Greater Williamson Road Area Business Association invites you to visit that busy commercial corridor during the annual Restaurant Week event that begins today.
